verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents on-request mail scanning, usually within 6 business hours, plus unlimited cloud storage with 24/7 access, so a scanned mail archive exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that scans are OCR'd or that the archive can be searched by sender, content or date. Missing for 10: OCR of scanned mail, full-text content search, sender and date search/filtering, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
